rc002_counterexample_failure_modes.description: Failure modes specifically reviewed for RC-002 counterexample obligations.

failure_modes.name: forced_unique_minima_resolution
failure_modes.description: Delta operator forces a unique selection among degenerate minima without valid tie-break basis.
failure_modes.impact: Artificial reduction of continuation complexity; loss of admissible branches.

failure_modes.name: multi_branch_tie_explosion
failure_modes.description: Failure to prune or resolve ties leads to unbounded branch generation in recursive updates.

failure_modes.name: orientation_locked_selection_bias
failure_modes.description: Secondary tie-break metrics create a persistent, unphysical bias in continuation selection.
failure_modes.impact: Systematic drift in orientation frame or state trajectories.

failure_modes.name: window_boundary_minima_instability
failure_modes.description: Degenerate minima near the admissibility window boundary lead to erratic selection or escape.
failure_modes.impact: Loss of transport closure; undefined transition flux.
